identification: Two framed artworks. (1) Large framed colour print of three galloping wild horses (grey, chestnut, black) in a dust storm, white/grey frame with blue-grey mount, approx 58x100 cm; artist not visible in photos, no signature readable. (2) Framed Venice lagoon scene (San Giorgio Maggiore, lamp post, gondolas) in pastel/chalk and watercolour wash, with an illegible signature at lower left under the mount. Catalogue says one print and one original; the Venice piece is presumably the original. Both generic decorative 1970s-80s style.
marks_seen: Lot tickets only on the frames. Venice piece has a scrawled signature at lower left, unreadable. Horses print has no visible signature or publisher text.
google_searches: Google: vintage print three galloping wild horses dust storm: only generic Etsy/canvas results, no identification of the artist.

identification: Lift-top Arts and Crafts style silky oak (Queensland) washstand with a hinged top over an inset enamel basin with brass plug and chain, a small mirror inside the lid, one panelled door below and a towel rail on the side. Brass plate on the front reads 'F. TRITTON LIMITED, House Furnishers & Manufacturers, 260 George Street, Brisbane'. Tritton was a Brisbane furniture maker (1900s-1960s). 'Limited edition' in the catalogue is likely a mistake or refers to a reproduction. Two enamel basins/pitcher visible inside. H81 W45 L70 cm.
marks_seen: Brass plate: F. TRITTON LIMITED / HOUSE FURNISHERS & MANUFACTURERS / 260 GEORGE STREET, BRISBANE. Enamel basin with chain and plug, brass door escutcheon, hinged mirror in lid.
google_searches: Google: F. Tritton Limited Brisbane silky oak washstand arts and crafts (Facebook marketplace posts of Tritton silky oak washstand cabinet asking $125 about 7 years ago; blanket box made 1931); Google Tritton Brisbane silky oak washstand sold auction price.
